detail.title: Dahua 32CH 2HDD 1U NETWORK VIDEO RECORDER
detail.overview: Compare Favourite NVR5232-EI Dahua 32CH 2HDD 1U NETWORK VIDEO RECORDER Key Points • Max. 384/384/384 Mbps Incoming/Recording/Outgoing Bandwidth • Max. Decoding Capability: 32 × 1080p@30 fps • IP Cameras Resolution Up to 32MP • 4K HDMI Output • 2 Bays. Each HDD Storage Capacity Up to 20TB • AI by Recorder: 2-ch Face Detection and Recognition, 8-ch SMD, 4-ch Perimeter Protection • N+M Cluster, iSCSI Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.AI by Recorder: Face detection; face recognition; perimeter protection; SMD Plus
General.AI by Camera: Face detection; face recognition; video metadata (human, motor vehicles, and non-motor vehicles); perimeter protection; SMD; stereo analysis; crowd distribution; people counting; ANPR; vehicle density; heat map; PPE detection; smart object detection; smart sound detection
General.Perimeter Performance AI by Recorder (Nu: 4 channels, 10 IVS rules for each channel
General.Face Attributes: Gender; age group; glasses; expressions; face mask; beard
General.Face Detection Performance of AI by Reco: 2 channels (up to 12 face images/s each channel)
General.Face Database Capacity: Up to 20 face databases with 20,000 images, with a total capacity of 2.5 G. Name, gender, birthday, address, credential type, credential No., countries & regions and state can be added to each face image.
General.Face Recognition Performance of AI by Re: 1. 16-channel FD (by camera) + FR (by recorder), image stream: 16 face images/s 2. 2-channe FD (by recorder) + FR (by recorder), video stream: 12 face images/s
General.SMD Plus by Recorder: 8 channels: Secondary filtering for human and motor vehicle , reducing false alarms caused by leaves, rain and lighting condition change
General.Human Attributes: Top color, top type, bottom color, bottom type, hat, bag, age, gender and umbrella
General.Motor Vehicle Attributes: License plate, plate color, vehicle body, vehicle model, vehicle logo, calling, seatbelt, vehicle interior, vehicle registration location.
General.Non-motor Vehicle Attributes: Vehicle model, vehicle color, number of persons, helmet.
General.License Plate Database Capacity: 1. Create up to 20,000 plate numbers. 2. Blocklist and allowlist
General.Network Bandwidth: AI disabled: 384 Mbps incoming, 384 Mbps recording and 384 Mbps outgoing AI enabled: 200 Mbps incoming, 200 Mbps recording and 200 Mbps outgoing
General.Resolution: 32 MP;24 MP;16 MP;12 MP;8 MP;6 MP;5 MP;4 MP;3 MP;1080p;720p;960p;D1;CIF;QCIF
General.Decoding Capability: AI disabled: 2-channel 32 MP@25 fps; 2-channel 24 MP@25 fps; 4-channel 16 MP@30 fps; 5-channel 12 MP@30 fps; 8-channel 8 MP@30 fps; 10-channel 6 MP@30 fps; 12-channel 5 MP@30 fps; 16-channel 4 MP@30 fps; 32-channel 1080p@30 fps AI enabled: 1-channel 32 MP@25 fps; 1-channel 24 MP@25 fps; 2-channel 16 MP@30 fps; 4-channel 12 MP@30 fps; 6-channel 8 MP@30 fps; 8-channel 6 MP@30 fps; 8-channel 5 MP@30 fps; 12-channel 4 MP@30 fps; 24-channel 1080p@30 fps
General.Video Output: 1 VGA, 1 HDMI VGA: 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720 HDMI: 7680 × 4320, 3840 × 2160, 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720 Heterogeneous video source output for HDMI and VGA
General.Third-party Camera Access: ONVIF; Panasonic; Sony; Axis; Arecont; Pelco; Canon; Hanwha
General.Video Compression: Smart H.265+; H.265; Smart H.264+; H.264; MJPEG
General.Network Protocol: HTTP; HTTPS; TCP/IP; IPv4; IPv6; RTSP; UDP; NTP; DHCP; DNS; SMTP; UPnP; IP Filter; FTP; DDNS; SNMP; Alarm Server; P2P; Auto Registration; IP Search (Supports IP camera, DVR, NVS, etc.); iSCSI
General.Interoperability: ONVIF 25.06 (Profile T; Profile S; Profile G; Profile M); CGI; SDK
General.Record Mode: General, motion detection; intelligent; alarm; POS
General.Playback Mode: Instant playback, general playback, event playback, target video, video clip, tag playback, smart playback (face and motion detection)
General.General Alarm: Motion detection; local alarm; alarm box; camera external alarm; network alarm; scene changing; PIR alarm; thermal alarm
General.Anomaly Alarm: Error (no disk; disk error; low space; low quota space; abnormal disk health; network disconnection; IP conflict; MAC conflict; abnormal fan speed); video loss; video tampering; camera offline; audio detection
General.Intelligent Alarm: Face detection; perimeter protection; face recognition; video metadata (human, motor vehicles, and non-motor vehicles); SMD Plus; stereo analysis; crowd distribution; people counting; ANPR; vehicle density; heat map; PPE detection; smart object detection; smart sound detection
General.Alarm Linkage: Record; snapshot (panoramic); local alarm output; IPC external alarm output; audio; buzzer; log, preset; email
General.Disk Interface: 2 SATA ports, each disk can contain up to 20 TB. This limit varies depending on the environment temperature.
General.USB: 2 (1 front USB 2.0 port, 1 rear USB 3.0 port)
General.Power Consumption: Total output of NVR is ≤ 10 W (without HDD)
